_: The machine, defined once. capture.mjs builds this and the page resumes into it; a savestate records the sizes the machine had, so a page that disagrees with the capture restores into the wrong shape and bugchecks. Anything here that differs between the two is a bug, which is why neither one carries its own copy.
_acpi: Must stay false: WINNT.SIF installed the Standard PC HAL, and v86 faults during XP startup with the ACPI one.
_boot_order: 0x132, hard disk first. The install ISO is long gone by this point.
_memory_note: 256 MB, not the 512 MB the install ran with. The disk does not care what it was installed with, and the savestate carries a flat copy of RAM, so this size is what every visitor downloads.
